sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Consumer Polling and Cross-Border Market Research Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (ROC-administered territory; separate customs and commercial-registration jurisdiction for cross-strait investment)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified, German-Japanese heritage) operating as an Unitary National system under the ROC Company Act (公司法) and Civil Code. A PRC-style Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture is not a recognized Taiwan statutory vehicle; the JV must be incorporated as a Taiwan-registered 有限公司 (limited company) or 股份有限公司 (company limited by shares) carrying mainland-capital (陸資) status under the Act Governing Relations between the Peoples of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, with prior approval from the MOEA Investment Commission.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed 2010, including services Early Harvest commitments
Cross-Strait Bilateral Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (海峽兩岸投資保障和促進協議), signed 2014, providing investor-protection and dispute-resolution standards for mainland investments in Taiwan

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Exact legal citations: (a) Money Laundering Control Act (洗錢防制法), comprehensively amended 2016-2018, Articles 6-10 (customer due diligence, 25% beneficial-ownership identification, five-year record retention, and suspicious-transaction reporting within 10 working days); (b) Company Act (公司法), Article 22-1, and the Company Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders Information Declaration Regulations (公司負責人及主要股東資訊申報及查詢辦法), requiring online declaration of directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding at least 10% to the MOEA restricted-access platform; (c) Act Governing Relations between the Peoples of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例), Articles 72-73, and the Regulations Governing Permission for Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Nationals (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法), administered by the MOEA Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會); (d) Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (資恐防制法) and its designation list; (e) Cross-Strait Agreement on the Use of Notarized Documents (兩岸公證書使用協議, 1993) for verified evidentiary authentication of PRC-origin corporate records.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Mainland Parent Business License, current-year stamped copy (營業執照)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC State Administration for Market Regulation / provincial 市場監督管理局
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a PRC notary office (公證處), transmission via ARATS (海協會) to the Straits Exchange Foundation (海基會) for verification; Hague Apostille not applicable in Taiwan, consular legalization is replaced by the 1993 Cross-Strait Notarial Verification mechanism

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized extract of the PRC parent's Articles of Association and certificate of incorporation history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC notary office on instructions of the parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization followed by SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification; no apostille route

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Board Resolution of the PRC parent approving the Taiwan investment, the JV capital contribution, and the authorized signatory (董事會決議暨授權書)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization followed by SEF verification; power-of-attorney must be countersigned by the authorized Taiwan counsel for the registry filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bilingual JV Contract and Taiwan-registrable Articles of Association (合資經營合同暨公司章程, simplified-to-traditional Chinese)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC notary office joint-certifying the mainland party's execution and the Taiwan counsel's conformity attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus SEF verification of the PRC signatures; the Taiwan-law charter (章程) is notarized separately by the Taiwan notary public at the incorporation stage

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements of the PRC parent for the preceding fiscal year (經會計師查核簽證之財務報表)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC licensed CPA firm and provincial Institute of Certified Public Accountants
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized duplicate transmitted through ARATS to SEF for verification; required by the MOEA Investment Commission for the mainland-investment permit

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax clearance / no-arrears certificate of the PRC parent (無欠稅證明)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC tax authority (主管稅務機關)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening: (1) run all UBOs (≥25%), statutory directors, supervisors, managers, and proposed bank/payment signatories against (i) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (ii) Taiwan's Counter-Terrorism Financing Act designation list (資恐防制名單), (iii) OFAC SDN and sectoral lists, (iv) EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and (v) PRC MOFCOM Unreliable Entity List and related restricted-entity databases; (2) classify domestic, foreign, and international-organization PEPs and their immediate family and close associates under FATF Recommendation 12 as transposed by Article 7 of the Money Laundering Control Act and the Regulations Governing AML/CFT for Financial Institutions; (3) document a written AML risk rating (standard, medium, enhanced) with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence where any PEP or sanctions-adjacent flag appears; (4) re-screen at each capital remittance event, upon signatory changes, and before enabling PayPal Mass Payout or Wise payout rails; the designated compliance officer must record the screening results in the JV's internal AML/CFT register.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs (經濟部商業發展署): Company and Commercial Registration Information Inquiry (商工登記公示資料查詢服務, findbiz.nat.gov.tw) for pre-clearance search; and the Company and Commercial One-Stop Online Application System (公司與商業及有限合夥一站式線上申請作業系統, onestop.nat.gov.tw) for filing the name pre-check (名稱預查).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be rendered in Traditional Chinese characters (正體中文). A corresponding English name may be filed as a secondary registered name, but pinyin-only names are not accepted as the statutory name. The permitted name tokens are controlled by the Taiwanese Standard Industrial Classification translation of the business scope; for ISIC 7320 the applicable Taiwan SIC category is 市場研究及民意調查業 (Market Research and Public Opinion Polling), and the name must conclude with 有限公司 or 股份有限公司 and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name in the same line of business.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 銀行/Bank (requires Financial Supervisory Commission prior approval)
電子支付/Electronic Payment (requires FSC licensing)
國際/International (requires verifiable cross-border business scope documentation)
中華民國/Republic of China (special authorization required; politically restricted)
台灣/Taiwan (permissible in general corporate names but subjected to heightened MOEA review for mainland-capital applicants)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Companies Act (Act No. 29 of 1929, as comprehensively amended), Articles 128-156 (incorporation mechanics), Article 8 (company name), Article 20 (capital verification), Articles 387-389 (registration); Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals for foreign shareholder participation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce, with the Investment Commission (MOEAIC) handling foreign investment approval; company registration is processed through the MOEA Company Registration Online System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation and Application for Company Registration (Form 1), submitted with the capital verification report to the MOEA company registration authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for this JV; however, the subscribed capital must be fully paid in cash and deposited in a temporary escrow bank account in Taiwan until registration is completed. The capital cannot be withdrawn until the company obtains its registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture (CN_JV_LTD) under the Taiwan Companies Act be approved; that the Articles of Incorporation as signed and notarized be adopted; that the company's registered office be located at the address stated in the Articles; that the subscribers listed in the share subscription list be allotted shares and that the capital contribution schedule together with the escrow deposit of subscription monies be ratified; that the directors and officers set forth in the election record be appointed; and that the managing director or president is authorized to execute all incorporation filings, instruct counsel, pay all fees, and take all lawful steps necessary to obtain the company registration certificate and business tax registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC), and MOEA Company Name Database
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed English and Chinese company names to the MOEA name screening system, and concurrently file the foreign investment application through MOEAIC online portal. Attach the joint venture agreement and articles of cooperation; obtain investment approval prior to incorporation filings.
required_dossiers: Joint Venture Agreement / Articles of Cooperation
Certificate of good standing for corporate foreign investors
Identification and background documents of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, propose up to three alternative names and resubmit; if investment approval is queried, provide supplemental corporate governance and source-of-funds documentation within 30 days or amend the proposed investment plan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Initial Registration Submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan District Court Notary Office or a commissioned civil attorney; MOEA Company Registration Online System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation, including share classes, capital amount, board composition, and registered office address. Have all shareholders or their appointed representatives sign the Articles before a notary. Submit the notarized Articles and the formal incorporation application to the MOEA online registration portal.
required_dossiers: Power of Attorney for each foreign shareholder representative
Photocopies of passports or national IDs of directors/shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a deficiency notice, timely file a corrected set of notarized Articles and an amended application form. Material discrepancies require re-execution of the Articles and payment of a bar recording fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized domestic bank in Taiwan and a licensed Taiwan Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the company's name at a Taiwan bank; remit the subscribed share capital from foreign shareholders into that account. Obtain a bank capital certification and instruct the appointed CPA to issue a capital verification report confirming that the paid-up capital is lawfully received and recorded.
required_dossiers: Bank certificate of deposit of subscription capital
Proof of source of funds for investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the escrow deposit because of incomplete source-of-funds documentation, gather and submit additional provenance evidence, such as audited financial statements or bank statements. The CPA may request a re-certification once the capital is cleanly posted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration and Issuance of Business Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce / South or North Regional Commercial Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the finalized registration application with the MOEA online system, attaching the notarized Articles, capital verification report, Investment Commission approval, and director/officer list. Pay the applicable filing fee. Upon approval, obtain the Company Registration Certificate and the unified business number.
required_dossiers: Investment Commission foreign investment approval letter
Directors and officers list with consent forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned, rectify the specified deficiencies in the portal and resubmit within the statutory cure period. If the fee amount was miscalculated, pay the difference via the portal's correction link and request expedited reissuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration (NTA), local tax authorities, and local Labor Bureau / Occupational Safety Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the statutory registration window after incorporation, register for Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax, Business Tax, and tax withholding obligations at the local NTA branch. Register as an employer with the Bureau of Labor Insurance, National Health Insurance, and Labor Pensions Office. Submit the lease or ownership evidence of the registered office for tax premise records.
required_dossiers: Office lease contract or building ownership document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is filed late, submit a written explanation and pay the nominal late-filing penalty; for labor registration issues, correct the registration immediately and request retroactive coverage with no break in insurance continuity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — non-industrial information service operation; no industrial manufacturing license is required for the Consumer Polling and Market Research Platform.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the SaaS survey platform; only a standard business tax registration and company registration certificate are required to operate lawfully.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Executive Yuan, Taiwan
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no manufacturing, factory premises, or physically land-intensive operations; office-based market research data processing is below all EIA screening thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; commercial office operations must comply only with municipal indoor air quality and waste management ordinances. If owned IT servers are introduced, electronic-waste recycling and standby energy consumption rules apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and building-use compliance inspection must be completed for the registered office under the Fire Services Act. Workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA) for computer workstation ergonomics and electrical safety is required; no structural load inspection is necessary for an office-based survey platform.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (Taiwan), National Taxation Administration; administered through regional National Taxation Bureaus. Primary online portals: Tax Portal (paytax.nat.gov.tw) and the Electronic Invoice Integrative Services Platform (einvoice.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor establishing a sino-foreign equity JV limited company in Taiwan must first obtain investment approval from the Department of Investment Review, Ministry of Economic Affairs. Upon incorporation with the Company Registry of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the company is automatically assigned a Unified Business Number (UBIN), which serves as its tax identification number. The JV must then file a Business Tax Registration (營業登記) with the local National Taxation Bureau within 15 days after business commencement; the tax bureau issues a tax registration certificate and validates the UBIN for VAT and corporate income tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the JV is a resident profit-seeking enterprise subject to 20% corporate income tax on Taiwan-sourced and worldwide net income, with foreign tax credits on foreign-source income. The entity is not a pass-through vehicle; Taiwan does not recognize check-the-box partnerships for limited companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Taiwan has no check-the-box entity classification election. A JV may elect optional simplified export VAT accounting for zero-rated sales, apply for advance pricing agreements, select IFRS as its accounting standard for tax alignment, and may claim tax credits under the Enterprise Free Trade Zone Act or Statute for Industrial Innovation if eligible. Hybrid mismatch and CFC regimes under Articles 43-3 and 43-4 of the Income Tax Act apply automatically; no elective hybrid mismatch rule is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT / GST (Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: NT$200,000 monthly average sales for standard VAT-payer registration with full invoice obligations; smaller-scale enterprises with NT$80,000 to NT$200,000 monthly average turnover must register but may apply the 1% special VAT rate; businesses under NT$80,000 monthly average turnover are conditionally exempt with MOF approval.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates electronic invoicing (Cloud Invoices) through the MOF E-Invoice Platform. Enterprises meeting prescribed turnover thresholds are required to use Turnkey service (API) to transmit electronic unified invoices to the National Taxation Bureau within statutory timeframes. B2C invoices use a common carrier cloud-invoice loop, and B2B invoices require near-real-time registration of invoice numbers and amounts. Digital time stamping and cryptographic validation are performed through the MOF platform; there is no physical fiscal stamp but a legally recognized electronic fiscal storage system with penalty sanctions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act for goods physically exported from Taiwan customs territory and for services supplied by Taiwan enterprises to persons outside Taiwan if the services are used, rendered or enjoyed outside Taiwan and paid for in foreign currency. The survey platform must demonstrate that the consumer-panel services and associated data outputs are furnished to overseas clients and do not involve local Taiwan consumers; a partial zero-rating election may apply to separately identifiable offshore service streams.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (出口報單 with proof of physical exit)
Matching commercial invoice and packing list
Ocean/air bill of lading or electronic logistics proof
Service contract and foreign-client acceptance evidence for offshore services
Inward remittance certificate or bank settlement record proving foreign-currency consideration received
Unified invoice (B2B or B2C) annotated with 0% tax rate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau audits zero-rated export claims by cross-checking customs clearance records, shipping manifests, bank foreign-exchange reports and service delivery logs. Any misdeclaration, forged documentation, or failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day statutory settlement window results in reversal of the zero-rating plus underpaid VAT at 5%. Under Article 51 of the Business Tax Act, the taxpayer is punishable by an additional penalty of up to five times the underpaid tax; where willful fraud is established, criminal liability under the Tax Evasion and Penalty Act may attach, and the Ministry of Finance may claw back refunds for a seven-year assessment period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary meeting resolution approving the financial statements and appropriation/distribution of profits
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOE) Company Registration Office (minutes and resolutions submitted for registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year entity, on or before June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible officers are subject to administrative fines of NTD 20,000–100,000; continued non-compliance may lead to MOE-ordered dissolution or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited or unaudited annual financial statements filed with the competent authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOE) Company Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after shareholders' approval; for calendar-year entities, no later than July 15 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company and responsible officers are subject to MOE administrative fines of NTD 20,000–100,000; after repeated failures the company may be subject to compulsory dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax annual return (annual corporate income tax filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year entities, on or before May 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 15% of underpaid tax per month up to 2 months; late-payment interest at statutory rates; a minimum late-filing penalty of NTD 1,500–30,000 may also be imposed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of corporate information and beneficial ownership/UBO register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOE) Company Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after any change in registered information; annual update submitted together with the annual filing cycle and not later than the shareholder-meeting filing deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines for failure to maintain or file UBO information under the Money Laundering Control Act; continued non-compliance may constitute grounds for dissolution by the competent authority.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit for companies with paid-in capital exceeding NTD 30 million (approx. USD 1 million), or where revenue exceeds NTD 100 million, or when required by MOE or the Financial Supervisory Commission; public-interest entities are always subject to audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS (IFRS as endorsed by Taiwan) for public companies; ROC Business Entity Accounting Act (local GAAP) for non-public companies; all annual financial statements must comply with the Company Act and the Regulations on Business Accounting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan companies must maintain a current register of ultimate beneficial owners and senior management in the statutory books. Any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register and reported to MOE within 15 days of the change; at the annual filing cycle, the company must reconfirm the recorded shareholding structure and UBO details as part of the annual corporate information disclosure.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200–800 per year for registered office and corporate agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000–15,000 per year for a Taiwan CPA statutory audit, depending on entity size and transaction volume
